6450.name: Kawhi Leonard

info.text: Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

6450.headline: Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

3102530.name: Jusuf Nurkic

info.text: He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

3102530.headline: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

3102531.name: Kristaps Porzingis

info.text: With Porzingis reportedly leaning toward retirement and no timetable for his return, he remains an extremely risky fantasy investment, with little reason to expect meaningful production this season.

3102531.headline: The Warriors have stopped issuing salary payments to Porzingis (illness), who remains away from the team and is considering retirement, Anthony Slater and Shams Charania of ESPN reported Wednesday.

3907387.name: Ben Simmons

info.text: Simmons suffered a season-ending right Achilles tear during practice Sunday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

3907387.headline: Simmons suffered a season-ending right Achilles tear during practice Sunday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

4594268.name: Anthony Edwards

info.text: Based on previous reporting from ESPN's Shams Charania, Edwards could miss up to two months.

4594268.headline: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

4683692.name: Cason Wallace

info.text: Although Wallace's return timetable has yet to be determined, Charania notes the guard is expected miss most of, if not all, of the rest of the season.

4683692.headline: Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

5061589.name: Yves Missi

info.text: He remains without a timetable to return and can be considered week-to-week moving forward.

5061589.headline: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

4397014.name: Quentin Grimes

info.text: Luka Doncic (back) is in the lineup following a one-game absence, pushing Grimes to the second unit.

4397014.headline: Grimes won't start Friday's game against the Warriors.

4431675.name: Trendon Watford

info.text: In his absence, DeAndre Jordan could re-enter the rotation, given Yves Missi (knee) remains out indefinitely.

4431675.headline: Watford (ankle) is out for Monday's game versus the Warriors.
